name: Media and social content datasets
venue_year: MovieLens 32M and Tag Genome 2021; HetRec 2011; LFM-1b ICMR 2016; Spotify MPD RecSys 2018; KuaiRec and KuaiRand CIKM 2022; MicroLens 2023

release_and_license.MovieLens 32M: Direct stable ZIP and checksums are live. Research use, acknowledgement and same-condition redistribution are allowed; commercial or revenue-bearing use requires GroupLens permission.
release_and_license.Tag Genome 2021: Direct GroupLens download is live; use the included README terms and freeze the exact release rather than ml-latest, which GroupLens says changes over time.
release_and_license.Last.fm HetRec 2011: The 2.5 MB owner-hosted ZIP is live and its README permits non-commercial use.
release_and_license.LFM-1b: The official JKU page explicitly says the dataset is no longer available for download due to license issues; reject third-party mirrors as primary provenance.
release_and_license.Spotify MPD: AIcrowd explicitly says the dataset is no longer downloadable and requests direct contact with Spotify Research. Terms are research/non-commercial and prohibit redistribution.
release_and_license.Spotify skip sessions: AIcrowd states since 2024-07-08 that the dataset is no longer downloadable and requests contact with Spotify Research.
release_and_license.KuaiRec and KuaiRand: Current Zenodo downloads and checksums are linked from author repositories; repositories state CC BY-SA 4.0.
release_and_license.MicroLens: The redesigned owner portal currently lists 50K, 100K and 1M files and video archives. Its declaration limits videos to academic use and prohibits modification or distribution without permission; exact license coverage for non-video tables is [uncertain].

input_history: MovieLens supplies earlier timestamped ratings/tags per anonymized user. LFM-1b historically supplied timestamped scrobbles; HetRec only aggregates artist listening counts, while its tag assignments have timestamps. KuaiRec and KuaiRand supply timestamped video exposures/views with watch-time feedback and stable user IDs. MicroLens supplies timestamp-ordered public user-comment interactions. Spotify MPD supplies ordered tracks inside playlists but no user ID; Spotify skip data supplies sessions but no durable user identity.
prediction_target: Predict a future semantic genre, tag, artist cluster or video category absent from the frozen user history. Prefer long-view, like, follow or repeated engagement over a raw impression as positive onset. MovieLens ratings and MicroLens comments are consumption/strong-engagement proxies, not verified watching. MPD can only predict withheld playlist tracks; Spotify skip can only predict skip within a session, so neither directly targets a user's future interest.
novel_interest_definition: A target is a future semantic concept absent from H(u), not merely a new movie, song or video ID. For MovieLens, distinguish new genre from new Tag Genome concept; for music, distinguish new track, artist and genre; for KuaiRec/KuaiRand, use the released hierarchical category names or caption-derived clusters. State that novelty is relative to observed data, never lifetime novelty.
novelty_granularity_and_reference_window: Use a frozen pre-cutoff user history and report item, creator/artist, leaf category/tag and ancestor category separately. MovieLens genres are coarse while Tag Genome relevance is fine-grained and computed post hoc. KuaiRand provides up to four semantic category levels in its supplement; KuaiRec now provides caption/category files and hierarchical raw categories. Playlist position is not a temporal user-history window.
interest_onset_definition: KuaiRand onset should be first long-view/like/follow in a new category after exposure; report click-only separately. KuaiRec can use first sufficiently high watch ratio in a new category. MovieLens onset is first positive rating in a new genre/tag concept, with rating-time caveats. MicroLens onset is first public comment on a new video concept. MPD track inclusion is playlist composition, not user-interest onset.

is_direct_match.KuaiRand: Strong short-window direct construction plus randomized-exposure validation.
is_direct_match.KuaiRec: Strong short-window direct construction with nearly fully observed user-item feedback in the small matrix.
is_direct_match.MovieLens: Dataset-only adjacent match: long chronology and stable users, but coarse semantics, no exposure and rating timestamps need not equal watch times.
is_direct_match.LFM-1b: Conceptually strong historical match, operationally rejected because the owner withdrew download access.
is_direct_match.HetRec Last.fm: Not a temporal listening match because user-artist listens are aggregated; timestamps apply to tag assignments, not listens.
is_direct_match.Spotify MPD and skip sessions: Not a longitudinal user match; playlist/session identifiers must not be promoted to user IDs.
is_direct_match.MicroLens: Dataset-only adjacent match with rich content and timestamps but positive-only public-comment sampling and release constraints.

persistence_signal: KuaiRand has thousands of sequential interactions per user and multiple feedback strengths, enabling later category re-engagement. KuaiRec supports repeated category engagement but the nearly complete small matrix is mostly one exposure per user-video. MovieLens can measure repeated later ratings in a category, not repeat consumption of the same movie. LFM-1b could measure repeated artist/genre listening but is unavailable. HetRec aggregates counts without sequence. MPD and skip-session data cannot establish cross-session persistence. MicroLens can measure repeated comments across related videos, not passive watching.
method: Create deterministic temporal user splits, map items to frozen semantic concepts, and predict first future concept onset plus later persistence. Compare popularity, creator/category transitions, sequential recommenders, multi-interest encoders and text/multimodal encoders. For KuaiRand, estimate metrics separately on standard-policy and randomized exposures; for KuaiRec, use the fully observed small matrix for candidate-complete counterfactual checks.
evaluation_protocol: Primary user-level protocol: burn-in/history, onset and persistence windows; no random event split. Evaluate category recall/NDCG, first-onset time, calibration and sustained-adoption recall, with repeat-item, new-item-known-category and new-category strata. MovieLens should use chronological ratings and user-disjoint secondary evaluation. KuaiRand should report standard logs and randomized pool separately. MPD's playlist-continuation protocol and Spotify's session skip protocol must not be interpreted as user-level new-interest evaluation.
generalization_axis: Seen-user temporal future, held-out users, cold items within known categories and new-to-user categories. MovieLens spans 1995-2023 but has platform and catalog drift. KuaiRec/KuaiRand test dense or randomized exposure over short windows. MicroLens mainly tests content-driven cold-item generalization. Playlist/session data tests context continuation, not durable-user generalization.
exposure_handling: KuaiRand is the strongest exposure resource: about 0.37% of standard-feed recommendations were replaced by an item sampled uniformly from a 7,583-video random pool, and is_rand marks interventions. KuaiRec's small matrix is 99.6% observed because almost every included user viewed every included video, though it is not a randomized full-platform catalog. MovieLens, Last.fm, MPD and MicroLens lack feed impression slates. Spotify skip rows are exposed tracks inside sessions but lack stable users and randomized propensities.
main_findings_and_limits: Use KuaiRand as the highest-priority causal/short-horizon benchmark and KuaiRec as a candidate-complete robustness benchmark. Use frozen MovieLens 32M plus Tag Genome as a long-horizon semantic robustness set, with strong warnings about ratings, post-hoc semantics and missing exposure. LFM-1b and Spotify MPD are not currently reproducible public choices. MPD has playlist IDs, not user IDs. MicroLens is valuable for multimodal cold-item experiments but its comments are selected strong positives and current license boundaries require care.

scale.MovieLens 32M: 32,000,204 ratings and 2,000,072 tag applications across 87,585 movies by 200,948 users, from 1995-01-09 to 2023-10-12; every sampled user rated at least 20 movies.
scale.Tag Genome 2021: 10.5 million computed tag-movie relevance scores from 1,084 tags applied to 9,734 movies.
scale.HetRec Last.fm: 1,892 users, 17,632 artists, 92,834 aggregated user-artist listening relations, 11,946 tags and 186,479 tag assignments.
scale.LFM-1b: More than one billion listening events; exact paper totals should be read from the withdrawn release documentation [uncertain].
scale.Spotify MPD: 1,000,000 playlists, more than 2 million unique tracks and nearly 300,000 artists, created 2010-2017.
scale.Spotify skip sessions: About 130 million public sessions plus about 30 million leaderboard sessions and nearly 4 million tracks.
scale.KuaiRec: Small matrix: 1,411 users, 3,327 videos, 4,676,570 interactions, 99.6% density. Big matrix: 7,176 users, 10,728 videos, 12,530,806 interactions, 16.3% density.
scale.KuaiRand: 27K version: 27,285 users, 32,038,725 videos and 322,278,385 interactions; randomized subset: 1,186,059 interactions over a 7,583-video pool.
scale.MicroLens: Paper: 34,492,051 users, 1,142,528 videos and 1,006,528,709 comment interactions; current public 1M subset contents and exact row counts should be hash-verified [uncertain].

stable_user_identity: MovieLens, Last.fm, KuaiRec, KuaiRand and MicroLens provide anonymized IDs consistent across their own files/windows. MovieLens IDs do not transfer across dataset releases. MicroLens users are public commenters, not necessarily viewers. Spotify MPD pid identifies a playlist, not a person; collaborative playlists further invalidate a one-playlist-one-user assumption. Spotify skip data is explicitly session based.
timestamps_and_order: MovieLens ratings/tags have Unix-second timestamps but files are ordered by user and movie, so callers must explicitly sort by timestamp. HetRec listening counts have no listen timestamps; only tag assignments are dated. KuaiRec includes human-readable time and Unix timestamps; KuaiRand includes millisecond timestamps and dated standard/random logs across 2022-04-08 to 2022-05-08. MPD has track position and one playlist modified_at value, not per-track add times. MicroLens records comment timestamps; exact current public subset fields are [uncertain].
left_censoring_and_history_coverage: MovieLens observes only ratings after user enrollment and requires at least 20 ratings, so first observed genre is not first watched genre; rapid backfilled ratings may distort chronology. KuaiRand covers about one month and KuaiRec a short platform window, making prior interests invisible. MicroLens captures only public comments and caps comments per video, creating severe positive and popularity selection. MPD samples filtered public playlists with dithering/fictitious tracks and cannot reconstruct a user's other playlists or listening history.
item_semantics: MovieLens has title, release year, coarse genres, user tags and external IMDb/TMDb links; Tag Genome supplies dense relevance to human-readable tags but is a computed snapshot. HetRec Last.fm has artist names and user tags; LFM-1b genre profiles use Last.fm tags plus external vocabularies. MPD has playlist title, track/artist/album names and URIs but no released genre taxonomy. KuaiRec now has captions, category text, tags and hierarchical raw categories. KuaiRand supplements provide captions/cover text and up to four category levels. MicroLens contains titles, tags, covers, audio and full videos.
feedback_and_exposure: MovieLens: ratings and tag applications, no impressions/watch. HetRec: aggregate play count and social/tag relations. LFM-1b: historical scrobbles. MPD: playlist membership/order, not consumption feedback. Spotify skip: exposed session tracks with skip labels. KuaiRec: view duration, duration and watch ratio plus dense exposure; no native like label. KuaiRand: 12 signals including click, like, follow, comment, forward, hate, long-view and play time, plus is_rand. MicroLens: public comments as strong positive proxies, plus item-level likes/views metadata.
candidate_space: KuaiRec small matrix has an almost complete 1,411-by-3,327 observed candidate block. KuaiRand's randomized pool of 7,583 videos has known randomized opportunities, but its 32-million-video standard catalog is not exhaustively exposed. MovieLens lists rated/tagged movies, not the full historically available catalog. MPD lists tracks appearing in sampled playlists, not recommendations shown. LFM/HetRec and MicroLens cannot reconstruct full contemporaneous candidate catalogs. Spotify skip supplies the already-served session sequence, not alternative candidates.
taxonomy_and_opportunity_drift: MovieLens release year helps gate movies, but Tag Genome scores are computed later and can leak future semantics unless treated as static content only. KuaiRec/KuaiRand category supplements were released after log collection; validate whether labels are contemporaneous and freeze mappings [uncertain]. KuaiRec has upload dates and daily item statistics; using future daily aggregates would leak outcomes. MicroLens collected popular seed/related videos over 2022-2023 rather than a complete platform catalog. Music rights and availability change by region and time but are absent.

construct_h_f_ynew.KuaiRand: Sort each stable user's standard and random exposures by time; H contains earlier long-view/like/follow category concepts, F contains later positive concepts, and Y_new=F-H. Evaluate within the random pool separately for exposure-valid negatives and require later repeated engagement for persistence.
construct_h_f_ynew.KuaiRec: Sort timestamped views; define positive concepts using a preregistered watch-ratio threshold; build H/F/Y_new from semantic categories. Use the small matrix for almost complete candidate evaluation and the big matrix for natural sparsity.
construct_h_f_ynew.MovieLens: Sort ratings; retain positive ratings under a declared threshold; map each movie to genres and frozen Tag Genome concepts; Y_new is a later positive concept absent from H. Run sensitivity excluding suspiciously rapid rating bursts.
construct_h_f_ynew.LFM-1b: Would support timestamped artist/genre H/F/Y_new and repeat scrobbles, but cannot be a reproducible benchmark while the official release is withdrawn.
construct_h_f_ynew.HetRec Last.fm: Cannot construct chronological listening F; tag-assignment onset is a different task.
construct_h_f_ynew.Spotify MPD/skip: Do not construct user-level H/F/Y_new; use only as method pretraining or playlist/session continuation.
construct_h_f_ynew.MicroLens: Sort comment interactions and define new tags/content clusters, but label the outcome as new public-comment engagement, not viewing interest; verify exact released timestamp schema first [uncertain].

leakage_and_missingness_risks: Risks include missing impressions, selected raters/commenters, left censoring, rating backfill, random event splits, creator popularity, future upload/daily-statistic leakage, post-hoc Tag Genome or category leakage, playlist-to-user identity error, session-to-user identity error, and sampled-negative inflation. Freeze dataset versions, user splits, item semantics and first-seen times; never infer dislike from unobserved media.

recommended_role.KuaiRand: High-priority causal and short-window new-category benchmark.
recommended_role.KuaiRec: High-priority fully observed candidate-space robustness benchmark.
recommended_role.MicroLens: Medium-priority multimodal/cold-item auxiliary after release and license audit.
recommended_role.HetRec Last.fm: Low-priority aggregate preference/tag resource, not temporal prediction.
recommended_role.LFM-1b: Reject for new experiments unless owner access is restored.
recommended_role.Spotify MPD and skip: Method inspiration/pretraining only; reject as longitudinal user benchmarks.

priority: High: KuaiRand and KuaiRec. Medium: frozen MovieLens 32M plus Tag Genome; MicroLens after exact-file and terms verification. Low: HetRec Last.fm. Reject/blocked: LFM-1b, Spotify MPD and Spotify skip sessions for reproducible longitudinal new-interest evaluation.
verification_status: Primary-source verified: MovieLens 32M exact schema, scale, dates and license; Tag Genome scale; HetRec Last.fm schema/license; official LFM-1b withdrawal; official AIcrowd MPD and skip-data withdrawal plus playlist/session semantics; KuaiRec/KuaiRand scale, fields, downloads, licenses and exposure design; MicroLens paper scale and current portal declaration. MicroLens current subset hashes/schema and the contemporaneity of later KuaiRec/KuaiRand semantic supplements remain [uncertain].
repeat_explore_and_persistence_audit: Partition future media events into repeat item, new item-known creator/category, new creator-known category, and new category. Then split new-category targets into one-off versus later repeated positive engagement. KuaiRand supports exposure-aware persistence; KuaiRec supports category persistence; MovieLens supports later distinct-movie ratings in the category. MPD/session data and aggregate HetRec listens fail the durable persistence audit.
evidence_quotes_or_schema_facts: MovieLens 32M README: 32,000,204 ratings, 2,000,072 tag applications, 87,585 movies and 200,948 anonymized users between 1995-01-09 and 2023-10-12; user IDs are consistent across ratings and tags.
GroupLens says ml-latest changes over time and is not appropriate for reporting research results; use the stable 32M release.
HetRec README: 92,834 user-artist relations contain listeningCount, while timestamps are provided for tag assignments, not listening events.
LFM-1b official page: the dataset is not available for download anymore due to license issues.
AIcrowd MPD page: the dataset is no longer downloadable; each entry is a playlist with pid, title, modified_at and ordered tracks, not a user record.
KuaiRec README: the small matrix has 4,676,570 interactions at 99.6% density and each included user viewed almost every included video.
KuaiRand README: about 0.37% of interactions were replaced by randomly sampled pool items; is_rand identifies intervention, and the random-policy log contains 1,186,059 interactions.
MicroLens paper: interactions are publicly observable comments with timestamps, not platform clicks or likes.
